name: duck-list-row
title: Duck List Row
description: The unit of a journal index, a project list, a changelog: HUD ordinal, title, meta, and a leading rule that grows in on hover while the row shifts to make room. asChild makes the whole row one link. Pass cells and the row lays itself out on the shared --duck-list-cols track list instead, for a column-aligned admin list under a DuckListHeader.
